title: Agent statement validation
responsibility: Validates and normalizes the short facts an owner supplies about an agent before those facts are stored.

inputs.name: agentStatement.input
inputs.description: Optional CLI strings for agent identity and work. Ids use 1–64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores and begin alphanumerically; units are comma-separated lowercase unit ids; pid and ttl must be positive whole numbers.

outputs.name: agentStatement
outputs.description: Normalized statement with trimmed text, sorted unique unit ids, numeric pid or null, and ttlSeconds defaulting to 900. Text limits are label 120, provider/model/loop 80, task/outcome 200 characters; units are at most 40, ttl at most 86400, and pid at most 2147483647.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown when the id or unit list has an invalid shape, a text field contains controls or exceeds its limit, or pid or ttl is outside its whole-number range. The message names the offending option.
